# SimplShot

> SimplShot is a free, open-source macOS app for capturing, annotating, and refining screenshots, images, and PDFs. It runs locally on macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later with no account, no subscription, and no tracking.

SimplShot is a native Mac screenshot and annotation tool created by Atle Mo. It is free forever and funded entirely by optional donations. Its standout features are one-click batch capture at multiple window sizes, reusable style templates, multi-page PDF annotation, OCR, and watermarks. It is a free, open-source alternative to Mac screenshot tools such as CleanShot X, Shottr, and Skitch.

## Key facts
- Name: SimplShot
- Platform: macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later (native Mac app)
- Price: Free and open source; optional donations via Liberapay
- Account required: No
- Privacy: Local-first — no tracking, no uploads; works fully offline
- Creator: Atle Mo
- Website: https://simplshot.com/
- Download: https://github.com/atlemo/SimplShot-App/releases/latest

## Features
- Annotation: arrows, lines, shapes, freehand drawing, numbered callouts, and text
- Blur and pixelate sensitive content (emails, passwords, private data)
- Highlight and dim to focus attention
- Pixel measurements for bug reports and design feedback
- OCR — extract text from any screenshot or image
- PDF annotation for single pages or entire multi-page documents
- Reusable style templates (background, padding, shadow, corner radius)
- Watermarks and logo overlays saved to templates
- Batch capture: capture any window at multiple preset sizes in one click
- Custom backgrounds and gradients, crop, color picker, keyboard shortcuts

## Who it's for
Developers, technical writers, support teams, indie makers, course creators, and QA engineers who capture, annotate, and share screenshots, images, or PDFs on macOS.

## Common questions
- Is it free? Yes — free and open source, with no account and no subscription.
- Does it annotate PDFs? Yes — single pages or entire multi-page documents.
- Does it collect data? No — local-first, no tracking, and works offline.
- What does it require? macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later.
- What is it an alternative to? A free, open-source alternative to CleanShot X, Shottr, Xnapper, Snagit, and Skitch. See https://simplshot.com/compare for a side-by-side comparison.
